description: Turn source code (C, C++, Java, Python or JavaScript, up to 80 lines) into a lab-record style flowchart where every box is linked to its code lines, plus a step-by-step dry run for a sample input (current line, box and variables at each step). Returns a link that opens it ready to play (▶ Explain), the program output and Mermaid code. Uses 1 AI credit.

code.description: The program or function, as source code.

sample_input.description: Optional input for the dry run, e.g. "n = 5". Picked automatically if left out.

name: code_to_flowchart
title: Code to flowchart with dry run
